findings.title: Unsupported/Deprecated Cryptographic Library: pycrypto (2.6.1)
findings.message: PyCrypto has been unmaintained since 2013, contains unpatched vulnerabilities, and is not FIPS 140-3 validated.
findings.aoc: AOC-09: Crypto Dependencies on Unsupported Libraries
findings.remediation: Migrate all cryptographic operations to 'cryptography' (pyca/cryptography >= 41.0.0) linked against a CMVP-validated OpenSSL 3 FIPS provider.

findings.title: Unsupported/Deprecated Cryptographic Library: cryptography (38.0.1)
findings.message: Detected version '38.0.1' is below baseline minimum '41.0.0'.
findings.aoc: AOC-09: Crypto Dependencies on Unsupported Libraries
findings.remediation: Ensure version >= 41.0.0 (Rust memory-safety bindings) and verify dynamic linkage against a CMVP-validated OpenSSL 3 FIPS provider rather than default static PyPI wheels.
